title: Better Start
description: A minimal, keyboard-focused new tab extension for Chrome and Firefox with a command grid, smart search, clock, weather, and elegant customization options.
body:
A distraction-free new tab extension with quick commands, smart search, clock widget, weather widget, themes & customization.

**Tech:** Vanilla JavaScript, Web Components, Shadow DOM, CSS Variables, Chrome Manifest V3, Firefox Manifest V2.

title: N-Queens: A Comparative Algorithm Analysis in Go
description: An implementation and performance comparison of four distinct algorithms to solve the N-Queens problem.
body:
Implements four algorithms: Exhaustive Search (Backtracking), Greedy Hill Climbing, Simulated Annealing, and Genetic Algorithm.

**Tech:** Go, Standard Library.

title: Cleveland Heart Disease Prediction with Logistic Regression
description: A comprehensive machine learning project that predicts heart disease using the validated Cleveland Heart Disease dataset with 82.1% accuracy.
body:
82.1% accuracy, 84.2% F1-score. Dataset: 920 patients, 16 original features.

**Key features:** High accuracy, real medical data, robust preprocessing, feature engineering (20+ features).

title: Turk-AdFilter: Turkish Ad & Tracker Blocking List
description: The most up-to-date list of Turkish ads to block ads on Turkish websites
body: Community-based, open-source filter list. Turkey-focused, continuously updated, compatible with uBlock Origin/AdGuard/Pi-hole.

title: Hür Kirpi Website
description: Hür Kirpi is a platform of thought that aims to defend freedoms and expand these areas of freedom.
body: Technologies: Astro, MDX, Sitemap, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Prettier, Lucide React.

title: Heat Solver Project
description: A efficient C++ heat equation solver with both serial and parallel implementations
body:
Serial and parallel implementations with OpenMP support.

**Tech:** C++, OpenMP, Devbox.

title: Purest Picks
description: Discover the essence of minimalism at Purest Picks.
body:
100/100 Lighthouse performance, Responsive, Accessible, SEO-friendly.

**Tech:** HTML5, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), Vite.

title: Yatırım Bot | @yatirimhaberi
description: Yatırım Bot is a Python-based project designed to automate the sharing of financial updates on Twitter.
body: Python-based project for automating financial updates on Twitter. Covers BIST, crypto, gold, silver, exchange rates.

title: Shipping Cost Calculator
description: A Java-based shipping cost optimization system for calculating the most cost-effective container combinations
body: **Tech:** Java, JDK 17+. Supports Small Container and Big Container types with weight-based pricing.
